name: Wakan Saimin ~Osananajimi no Kanojo wa Saimin Playmates~
original_name: 和姦催眠～幼馴染の彼女は催眠PlayMates～
source:
Shintarou is in love with his childhood friend Shouko, but since she's (apparently) oblivious of him he lacks the courage to confess to her.
But one fateful day, Shintarou discovers an alternate, and VERY powerful, solution to his dilemma...
